Applicant Anil Singh is in judicial custody in FIR/Case Crime No.560 of 2022, dated 26.11.2022,

sentences.text: He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the victim was staying in a shelter home and studying in Class IX.
On 25.11.2022, it was found that the victim was not well.
She was suspected with the pain.
When inquired, she revealed that the co-accused established physical relations with her when she had gone to her village during summer vacation.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim has named the applicant and the co-accused as the persons, who raped her during summer vacation in her village, due to which, she became pregnant.
But, it is argued that the Forensic Science Laboratory Report denies that the applicant had any relation with the victim.
It is argued that the applicant was not found to be the biological father of the foetus.
5. Learned State counsel admits these facts.
